Subject: Welcome: Atlas Pharma launch orientation — scheduling

Hi Alice —

Great to meet you (virtually) last week. We're excited to get Atlas Pharma into the platform. To make the first week smooth, we'd like to lock a 60-minute kickoff/orientation to cover: account owners, runbook, access, SSO & onboarding prework, and the week-0 checklist.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Sep 16, 09:00–10:00
- Tue Sep 16, 13:00–14:00
- Wed Sep 17, 08:30–09:30

Can you confirm which slot works, and who from your side should join (names + roles)? If none of these work, tell us a couple of windows and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.pdf (high-level prework), kickoff-agenda.docx (draft).

Who from Redwood will attend: myself (Customer Success / Launch lead), Camila Reyes (Technical PM), Ben Carter (Operations). I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and meeting link once we agree.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Alice —

Thanks for confirming — Tue Sep 16 at 13:00 PDT is locked on our side.

Quick answers:
- Okta: a test user + SAML metadata would be ideal. If you can share the metadata file or an admin SSO contact, we’ll import and validate before the call.
- Network: outbound TLS (443) to our bridge endpoints is all that’s required; I’ll paste the minimal CIDR + IP ranges in the shared drive doc. No inbound ports necessary.
- Runbook: attached is a pared-down runbook excerpt we’ll run through during the orientation — Ben will lead the run-of-show and the hands-on walk-through.

Draft agenda (60m):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m) — Jordan
2) Architecture & access (10m) — Camila
3) SSO / accounts (10m) — Rajiv + Camila
4) Runbook walkthrough / dry-run (20m) — Ben
5) Next steps / action items (10m) — Jordan

Meeting hosts/roles:
- Jordan (CS lead) — overall success & next steps
- Camila (Tech PM) — architecture, SSO, access
- Ben (Ops) — runbook, bridge, recordings, recordings + follow-ups
- Kimberly (Onboarding specialist) — account defs & billing handoff (will join for handoff notes)

Meeting link (provisioned): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode on calendar invite). I’ll upload the runbook excerpt to the Drive link ahead of the meeting.

[Attachment: runbook-excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

— Camila
